note: Site canvas coords. Each frame: a list of sprites, drawn in order. Usually two boots (far first; draw the far one 15% darker); s = which sprite (a drawing of the walk cycle), x,y = bottom-centre of that sprite, rot = 0. Draw the boots clipped to stagehand/gap_mask.png placed at gap_mask_xy, so they only show in the dark gap under the backdrop (ladder, pots and cart stay in front). Entries with body=true are his whole body (one drawing, by the curtain): draw them NOT darkened, mirrored left-right if flip=true, clipped to stagehand/body_mask.png placed at body_mask_xy, instead of the gap mask.
